evals.prompt: Take that postmortem we just went through and give me a markdown report I can attach to the PR.
evals.expected_output: A Report-mode .md file at reports/YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>.md whose first line is `---`, whose frontmatter is a valid YAML `report:` block, and whose body uses the numbered-section and component conventions
expectations: Invokes the output-markdown skill rather than pasting the report into the conversation
Reads assets/template.md and references/components.md from the skill folder — not a remembered copy of either
Byte 0 of the written file is `-`: the YAML frontmatter opens on line 1 with no comment, heading, or blank line above it
The frontmatter parses under a strict YAML parser and uses the `report:` block (title, kind, date, topic), never a `crispy:` block with empty phase/status/ticket keys
The string `{{` does not appear anywhere in the written file
Applies the SKIP RULES: no orphan header-blockquote segment, no empty backticks, and no summary-table row whose value is blank
Body sections are numbered `## 01.`, `## 02.`, `## 03.` … monotonically with no gaps
Reports the written file path back to the conversation along with any slots it derived itself

evals.prompt: CRISPY delegation: /research-codebase --format=md has finished its synthesis and hands over a render brief with phase=research, a status, a ticket line, and numbered body sections.
evals.expected_output: A CRISPY-mode .md file under research/docs/YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>.md carrying the full crispy:* frontmatter set, with every human-facing key mirrored as a summary-table row
expectations: Invokes in CRISPY mode and writes under research/docs/ using the caller-supplied stem plus `.md` — it does not fall back to the Report-mode reports/ default
Frontmatter starts on line 1, nests the keys under `crispy:`, and parses as valid YAML
Every human-facing `crispy:` key has a matching row in the summary table; frontmatter-only internals such as `crispy:git_commit` correctly have no row
The status renders as the emoji plus the backticked status string, with the emoji chosen from the status prefix (any `ready-for-*` value maps to ✅)
The string `{{` does not appear anywhere in the written file
Derives REPO, BRANCH, and DATE via the shell in one parallel Bash call rather than inventing values
Uses GFM constructs (pipe tables, fenced blocks with language hints, `> [!NOTE]` alerts, `<details>` for deep dives) and does not reach for CSS or HTML layout markup

evals.prompt: Write a Python script that reads the YAML frontmatter out of every file in research/docs/ and prints a table of phase and status.
evals.expected_output: A Python script written directly, with no output-markdown invocation — this is code that processes Markdown, which the description explicitly excludes
expectations: Does NOT invoke the output-markdown skill: the request is to write a Markdown-parsing program, not to render content as Markdown
Does not read assets/template.md or apply the slot-substitution procedure
Writes the requested Python script as an ordinary coding task
